question: I'm examining how documented conservation responses to biodiversity loss align with the stated limitations and failures of those responses. Please build a complete inventory of all relevant conservation responses covered in the documentation—not just examples—and for each one report only the properties, distinctions, mechanisms, constraints, or findings explicitly stated in its own entry, without requiring any information the entry omits. When an entry notes terminology differences, disagreements, boundary conditions, limitations, or uncertainty, record those as well. An overview may help frame the research, but it cannot replace the item-specific supporting entries for individual claims. The goal is to reconcile documented conservation goals with documented outcomes, clearly separating positive effects from shortcomings.
